synthesis.body: pip install -e packages/<pkg> records one absolute path, so with several Conductor workspaces on the same repo the global interpreter resolves that package from whichever workspace installed it last. Local gates then exercise a different checkout and pass or fail for reasons unrelated to your diff; when that workspace is deleted the import fails outright mid-session. Re-running the editable install just re-points the trap. Install into the workspace's own gitignored .venv instead and drive every local gate through .venv/bin/python, leaving the global interpreter on PyPI builds. Detect editables via pip list (shows a path) or dist-info/direct_url.json carrying dir_info.editable true.

title: A monorepo editable install resolves to one workspace for the whole machine
